title: Romantic Getaway to Vietnam: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Vietnam. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Vietnam sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Trypinn Team
content:
There is something about Vietnam that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a romantic getaway to Vietnam, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Vietnam
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Vietnam](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1557750255-c76072a7aad1?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Vietnam's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Vietnam.
